mapping.standard_mapping_strategy: Each selected_requirements_lab_requirement_ids entry resolves through the pinned corpus bundle to one canonical 2025 document_id:clause_id; query test for the full requirement-to-section table, query trace for one bounded direct test-to-requirement-to-section record, or query section for every mapped test at one exact clause/subsection. The next --summary view exposes the indexed slice's canonical section keys without expanding the full plan.
mapping.first_read_strategy: Read QUERY-CARD.md first. It is intentionally short; QUERY-GUIDE.md, ROADMAP.md, and IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md are deeper references and should be opened only after work/trace/check identifies the exact slice.
mapping.test_query_strategy: Use work for the single active implementation slice, focus for one exact lane's bounded candidate/status card, an exact test_case string for one regression, trace for one exact plan/test/requirement/section/lane handle, a stable Catch2 tag for a lane, requirement/section for reverse traceability, and recent --summary --compact for the newest completion ledger entries. Do not infer work from a full-suite scan.
mapping.trace_query_strategy: trace resolves exact plan id or TEST_CASE title first, then exact Lab or contract requirement id, exact canonical 2025 document_id:clause_id (or clause-only suffix), then an exact Catch2 lane tag. It never falls back to fuzzy search; use search explicitly for discovery. Each trace row pairs the selected requirement id with its canonical 2025 subsection and title, plus the C++ source location, API surfaces, and owning roadmap families.
mapping.focused_check_strategy: Use check --lane <exact-tag> as the iteration-local integrity gate: roadmap structure and 2025 references remain checked globally, while test/source and completion-ledger validation is limited to the selected lane. Unlocated historical rows stay visible as source drift; unscoped check is the strict whole-plan reconciliation gate.
mapping.focused_lane_strategy: Use focus [<exact-catch2-tag>] --summary --compact after work: it resolves the active lane, separates source-located executable candidates from implemented and source-drift rows, and prints owner, requirement/section counts, and copyable lane handles. Use --json for automation; use --limit 0 only for an intentional complete candidate list.
mapping.test_source_location_strategy: Derived per query from TEST_CASE declarations beneath cpp/tests; grouped semicolon-separated plan entries resolve to each matching declaration. Entries marked source-missing-needs-reconciliation are retained for requirement history and surfaced by the unlocated query until their declaration is restored or the catalog entry is superseded.
mapping.source_plan_strategy: Use unplanned --path <source-file> to list source TEST_CASE declarations with no exact Catch2 plan row; this is a bounded reconciliation queue and never infers requirements, status, or roadmap ownership.

test_status_semantics.source-missing-needs-reconciliation: Requirement and subsection history retained, but the current checkout has no matching TEST_CASE declaration; query with unlocated before restoring or superseding the entry.

next_source_state_semantics.planned: A future C++ TEST_CASE target with its file, lane, requirement, subsection, and API contract recorded; it is not executable evidence until the declaration and plan row exist.
next_source_state_semantics.unplanned-source: A source TEST_CASE declaration exists without an exact plan row; query it with unplanned and add an explicit mapped plan row before treating it as evidence.

items.current_focus: The bounded 2025 C++ spine has explicit indexed status across all 840 Requirements-Lab Catch2 plan entries. Recent slices retain exact TEST_CASE pointers, assertion counts, callback models, lane tags, requirement IDs, and canonical sections. The public process endpoint now covers Connect/Create/Join/NoAction Resign, server-owned lookup, receive-order interaction/declaration, object publication/registration, subscription/discovery, ordinary and timestamped regional Update/Reflect delivery, reciprocal regional Attributes Out Of Scope/Attributes In Scope transitions, additive source-region association/unassociation transitions, disjoint-region suppression, and the 2025 dimension/region lifecycle through the private ProcessFederationClient seam. The focused process-boundary lane is 38 executable cases / 1617 focused-JUnit assertions; the local-delete codec adds 9 direct assertions, the private registry integration records 44, the public local-delete endpoint integration records 18, the Delete Object Instance codec records 25, the public Delete Object Instance endpoint integration records 25, and the public timestamped Delete Object Instance endpoint integration records 64 under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE; each slice records its source line, requirements, and 2025 clause mapping. The private m24 process service projection and public m25 configured-endpoint Attribute Relevance Advisory callback bridge are green under both HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE dispatcher paths, m26 covers callback-entry suppression of a stale evoked advisory after switch disable, m27 covers public regional association transitions under both callback models, m28 covers public regional subscription removal and restoration under both callback models, m29 covers the initial regional registration/discovery advisory under both callback models, m31 covers active update-rate reissue, and m32 covers regional explicit-rate retention, m33 covers public active-rate reissue, and m34 covers public regional explicit-rate retention, m35 covers embedded regional callback-entry rechecking under both callback models, and the directed-interaction callback slice covers ordinary, timestamped, callback-disabled queued, timestamped-retraction-before-receive, and timestamped-retraction-after-receive delivery through the public process endpoint, including exactly one legal official Request Retraction callback after delivery under both HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE. The eight installed-profile package lanes and catalog guard remain green, including the dedicated public directed-interaction/retraction consumer. The complete installable-package gate and retained package/JUnit evidence are green; the next bounded task is to implement the indexed HLA_IMMEDIATE companion for timestamped regional Update Attribute Values without rescanning the unchanged Requirements Lab. Use queue, work, next, recent, lane, test, requirement, section, trace, unlocated, unmapped, and unplanned queries; do not rescan the unchanged Requirements Lab.
